programme.desc: John Simpson looks back at his extraordinary 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global stories of the era. programme.desc: Valencia, Spain Jasmine Harman jets off to Spain to help retired teachers Gloria and Russell, who've chosen vibrant Valencia as the perfect place for their dream holiday home. With a budget of £115,000, Jasmine shows Gloria and Russell five great options.
programme.title: A Place in the Sun

programme.desc: Poitou-Charentes Stephen and his daughter Stephanie are moving to the stunning French region of Poitou-Charentes, where they plan to run a glampsite. Jasmine Harman helps them find their dream place for £250k.
programme.title: A Place in the Sun

programme.desc: Paralympic Special As the Paralympic Games 2020 approach, five stars take on the culinary competition. Can dressage champion Natasha Baker ride off with the prize with her winter-warmers?
programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.desc: Paralympics Special On day two, judoka Chris Skelley's menu confuses one guest, while his starter impresses another. But what do they think of his rendition of a karaoke classic?
programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.desc: Paralympics Special Paralympic presenter Arthur Williams goes all out with an international menu featuring fondue from Switzerland, nasi goreng from Asia, and apple crumble from the UK.
programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.desc: Paralympics Special Wheelchair basketball star Amy Conroy hosts a night fit for historical heroes including Albert Einstein, Julius Caesar, Audrey Hepburn and a suffragette. She hopes her esteemed guests enjoy a game of beer pong.
programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.desc: Paralympics Special Retired swimmer Liz Johnson takes her turn to host, and serves up some of her personal favourites on a night featuring fishy goings-on, bonding over leftovers and a kazoo competition.
programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.desc: S13 E61 — Ship Inn The competition starts at the Ship Inn in Dymchurch, Kent run by 21-year-old partners James Tindall and Jessica Walton, who believe age is but a number. Over breakfast, a frank airing of views sets the standard for the week.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S13 E62 — Thompson Hall Retreat The second visit is to Thompson Hall Retreat in Norfolk, run by mother and daughter duo Amanda and Becci. On arrival, everyone is wowed by the stylish shepherd huts with outside bath.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S13 E63 — The White House The third visit this week is to The White House, in Swansea, owned by entrepreneurs Lloyd and Marta. On arrival, the guests receive a welcome that leaves two pairs scratching their heads.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S13 E64 — Jacobs Plough The final visit is to Jacobs Plough in Bicester, Oxfordshire, run by manager Duncan Froomes and bar supervisor Ryan Hunt who like to mix banter with business. The criticism continues, with feedback that leaves the hosts praying for a miracle.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S13 E65 — Payment Day It is the final day of the competition and the bed and breakfast owners are meeting for the last time. After dramatic discoveries and frank exchanges, the payments are revealed, and the winners announced.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S15 E9 — Episode 9 Paramedics treat a woman with pain in her head who has previously undergone brain surgery, a patient who's taken cocaine and a woman who's struggling to breathe.
programme.title: 999: On the Front Line

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Episode 5 Nat and Leonard battle to save an elderly woman after a suspected stroke. Taz and Amanda help a child trapped in a car.
programme.title: Paramedics

programme.desc: S3 E14 — Under the Influence Eleven-year-old Archie has tripped and fallen up a step at the school library and has badly cut his lip. Archie's worried about stitches, but he's also concerned about his rumbling tummy; he hasn't had his favourite dinner of chicken and chips.
programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Grilled Chicken 3 Ways Chef Dale Talde amps up your chicken dishes by making smoky chicken wings, a whole roasted turmeric ginger chicken with tamarind sauce, and chicken patties grilled in banana leaves with chili lime noodles. A frosty lime rickey finishes it all off!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consommé, and an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, giardiniera.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Grill These Sandwiches Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Summer Seafood Smorgasbord Chef Dale Talde gets his beach vibes going with a grilled shrimp & lobster cocktail, clams with lemon breadcrumbs, a killer grilled king crab with burnt citrus butter, and a chilled mango frozen daiquiri. Don't you dare miss this beach party!
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E07 — New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po'boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E08 — End of Summer Seafood Feast The end of summer is near, and Chef Dale makes a giant seafood feast; lobster, crab, clams, shrimp, and scallops, all served directly on the table with plenty of buttery garlic bread.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Perfectly Prepared Steaks Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you've ever eaten.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Brunch on the Grill Chef Dale greets the day with a Dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with crème fraîche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Pizza Party on the Grill It's Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much-needed upgrade.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Kabobs and Skewers Kabobs and skewers are a family tradition for Chef Dale; a Mediterranean-inspired meal features beef and shrimp kabobs with grilled tomatoes, potatoes, and eggplant, all served on warm pita with a tangy white sauce.
programme.title: All Up In My Grill

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E06 — Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S07 E09 — Chinese Take Out With the help of a friend, Frankie serves up easy and delicious recipes based on take out favorites everyone will enjoy at home. No need to shell out extra cash for delivery fees!
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E03 — Eat Your Greens Going green isn't just a trend; it's a no-brainer! When the veggies are in season and the prices are at their lowest, Frankie's colorful recipes and zero waste tips will have you celebrating the savings with fresh spring produce.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E06 — But First, Brunch Bring your loved ones together over a delicious brunch spread made with love. Whether you're celebrating a major milestone or simply toasting to the weekend, Frankie's money-saving menu will have guests buzzing for more.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S07 E01 — Pizza My Heart On this special delivery episode of Struggle Meals, Frankie explores three ways to make delicious pizzas, and shares clever tips to make an A+ pie without dropping your dough on expensive ingredients.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E09 — Picnic Lunches It's field trip day, and Frankie shows off his best handheld lunches perfect for leisurely days at the park, the beach or the pool. These sturdy meals are made to travel and only get better with time.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E04 — Between Two Buns Is it a burger? Is it a sandwich? Could a burger actually be a sandwich? Not even Frankie knows the answer, but one thing is certain: whatever you want to call them, these fun twists and familiar flavor combos are super satisfying to scarf down.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E07 — Saved By The Bowl When you're craving a quick nutritious meal, say no more to throwing cash down the gutter for overpriced takeout bowls! Frankie recreates three restaurant favorites for a fraction of the cost, sparing your bank account without sacrificing flavor.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S08 E05 — Struggle Splurge The key to treating yourself on a budget is to keep it simple: these elegant dinners taste like restaurant specials, but they can be prepared in under one hour - perfect for easy weeknight meals for a family of any size on a busy schedule.
programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!
programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Smoked Brisket Hero Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Mexican Carne Asada Hero Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Pulled Pork Party Hero It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Steakhouse Hero Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Weeknight Family Dinner Hero Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E10 — Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E03 — The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E04 — The Secret to Texas-Style Smoked Brisket Pat and his buddy Leonard Botello use the flavors of the beloved native Post Oak to smoke a perfect Central Texas-style beef brisket.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E01 — West Tennessee Whole Hog Pat Martin teams up with fellow pitmasters to showcase the rugged and nuanced tradition of whole-hog cooking, West Tennessee-style.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E07 — South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E09 — Hunting for Quail in Charleston Pat and his pal Jason Stanhope meet up outside of Charleston for a day of quail hunting and grilling birds over live coals.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Greek Spit Roast Lamb Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Red Curry Braised Pork with Mustard Greens Pat Martin is in the frozen tundra of Minnesota to visit his new friend, Chef Yia Vang. They brave the cold and break nearly-frozen ground to barbecue a pig's head in the earth.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Barbecued Pork Steak Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E08 — The Roscoe Family Legacy: Alabama Pit Ribs Pat heads to Birmingham to team up with artist and chef Roscoe Hall, cooking ribs inspired by Roscoe's family legacy.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Live Fire Whole Trout Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E10 — Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: Po gorszym początku sezonu Paryżanie wrócili do poziomu, którym zachwycali kibiców na całym świecie. W poprzedniej serii spotkań wygrali z Le Havre AC aż 5:1. W 10. kolejce Paris Saint-Germain podejmie ESTAC Troyes. Przyjezdni odnieśli ostatnio drugie ligowe zwycięstwo w tym sezonie, pokonując 2:0 Le Mans FC.
programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Paris Saint-Germain - ESTAC Troyes

programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.
programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa

programme.desc: Twórcy przypominają historyczny sezon Werderu zakończony zdobyciem podwójnej korony: mistrzostwa Bundesligi i Pucharu Niemiec. W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.
programme.title: Werder Double

programme.title: Najlepsi bramkarze Bundesligi lat 90

programme.desc: Lothar Matthaeus Biografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.
programme.title: Legendy ligi niemieckiej

programme.desc: Thomas Haessler, Christian Ziege, Mehmet Scholl, Stefan Effenberg, Andreas Moller... w latach 90. po boiskach niemieckiej Bundesligi biegało wielu świetnych pomocników. Piłkarze grający na tej pozycji walnie przyczynili się do sukcesów reprezentacji Niemiec w ostatniej dekadzie XX wieku.
programme.title: Najlepsi pomocnicy Bundesligi lat 90

programme.desc: Freiburg imponuje formą. Po ośmiu kolejkach znajduje się na trzeciej lokacie i traci zaledwie 2 punkty do liderującego Bayernu Monachium. Przeskoczyć aktualnego mistrza Niemiec chce starciem z Unionem. Zespół z Berlina po fatalnym początku sezonu zaczął wstawać z kolan i w ostatnich meczach zdobył 6 oczek, tym samym przybliżając się do opuszczenia strefy spadkowej.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: SC Freiburg - 1. FC Union Berlin

programme.desc: Joshua Kimmich Joshua Kimmich to jeden z najzdolniejszych defensywnych piłkarzy młodego pokolenia w Niemczech. Jest filarem Bayernu Monachium i reprezentacji Niemiec. To jeden z tych zawodników, do których należy piłkarska przyszłość.
programme.title: Moi bohaterowie

programme.desc: Rudi Voeller Biografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.
programme.title: Legendy ligi niemieckiej

programme.desc: Stefan Kuntz, Mario Basler, Fredi Bobic, Ulf Kirsten, Toni Polster i wielu innych zachwycało kibiców swoimi umiejętnościami na boiskach Bundesligi w latach 90. ubiegłego stulecia. W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.
programme.title: Najlepsi napastnicy Bundesligi lat 90

programme.desc: Marsylia po fatalnym początku sezonu i 4 porażkach w 5 meczach wstała z kolan. Ostatnie 4 kolejki to 4 zwycięstwa, dzięki czemu znalazła się 6. miejscu w Ligue 1. Nie ma jednak zamiaru się zatrzymywać i kolejny komplet punktów chce zdobyć w pojedynku z RC Lens. Zespół Michała Skórasia z kolei spróbuje się podnieść po przegranej 1:9 w Lidze Mistrzów.

programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. programme.desc: Bayer 04 Leverkusen w poprzedniej kolejce przegrał drugi mecz z rzędu w lidze. Tym razem musiał uznać wyższość VfB Stuttgart, ulegając 2:4. O powrót na zwycięską ścieżkę powalczy w ramach 9. kolejki na wyjeździe z 1. FC Köln. Gospodarze mają za sobą remis 1:1 z Unionem Berlin.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: 1. FC Köln - Bayer 04 Leverkusen

programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.
programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Vitoria SC - FC Porto

programme.desc: Frosinone jest jedną z niespodzianek pierwszej części sezonu. Obecnie znajduje się na szóstej lokacie i traci zaledwie 3 punkty do miejsc pozwalających na grę w Lidze Mistrzów. Przybliżyć się do nich chce starciem z notującym spadek formy Cagliari. Zespół z Sardynii przegrał 4 ostatnie mecze ligowe i spadł na dwunastą pozycję.
programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Cagliari Calcio - Frosinone Calcio

programme.desc: Werder Brema w ubiegły weekend przedłużył serię bez porażki, wygrywając 2:0 z TSG Hoffenheim. W najbliższej kolejce podopieczni Daniela Thioune zagrają na wyjeździe z VfB Stuttgart. Gospodarze również sięgnęli po trzy punkty w poprzedniej serii spotkań, pokonując 4:2 Bayer Leverkusen.
programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: VfB Stuttgart - Werder Brema

programme.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.
programme.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922

programme.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.
programme.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928

programme.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.
programme.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933

programme.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.
programme.title: The Racial State 1933-1934

programme.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.
programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940

programme.desc: Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.
programme.title: Auschwitz One Day

programme.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.
programme.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis

programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.
programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis

programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.
programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs

programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.
programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation

programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Always Money in Philadelphia
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, the guys face a shady bidder with inside information and former NFL star Vince Papale in a battle for a vintage football passing machine and a colonial musket that could be worth huge money if it's real.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: With Ton missing, Allen struggles to keep the pawn shop afloat while training Elle to work an auction. After a fierce bidding war with Caroline, pieces from a century old motorcycle may not be enough to save the day. ed.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Flying Ton, Creeping Allen
programme.desc: When a group of thugs try to bully Ton and Allen out of a Chinatown auction, the guys fight back, leading to a violent showdown and the discovery of both a rare Bornean blowgun and special effects wire harnesses.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Missouri Loves Company
programme.desc: On a visit to see Ton's sister in Missouri for some rafting and relaxation, the guys hit up a fast-paced live auction. After some tough losses, Ton and Allen score a ballista and an anvil set made for an explosive sport.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Brew-Phoria
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go all in for an electric car, but with the batteries missing, a pricey refurb is their only shot at a profit. Will a home brewing system and high-end air rifles help soften the blow, or will they take a big loss?

programme.title: Auction Hunters: You Got Served
programme.desc: After a crushing defeat, the guys leave an auction empty handed and scramble to find new merchandise at a yard sale. But questionable antique tennis rackets and an ancient special effects box may not earn them a cent.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rock and Roll
programme.desc: An auction in Whittier gets ugly when a buyer named Big Dave tries to take it all. After some tough losses, the guys win a state of the art food truck and an off-road rock crawler with dangerous consequences.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hook, Line & Printer
programme.desc: A last-minute auction in Norwalk proves challenging when Ton and Allen go toe-to-toe with a real life cowboy couple. When the dust settles, the guys uncover a 3D printer and a grappling hook gun they can't wait to shoot.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Machine Gun Ton
programme.desc: Ton and Allen battle a pair of vicious female auction hunters who have an axe to grind and bid based on spite rather than strategy. And a gatling gun & suit of armor are worth much less than the guys expected.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Risk & Reward
programme.desc: Ton & Allen arrive late to an auction. They uncover vintage bear traps and a bounty of street art. If the pieces belong to the artist, RISK, it could be their biggest score ever. If not, they'll be stuck with forged knockoffs.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Space Cowboys
programme.desc: With the pawn shop history, Ton and Allen start the next chapter of their careers with a bang. They uncover an antique WWII firearm and a Russian cosmonaut space suit, which could be their biggest find to date...if it's real.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton Voyage
programme.desc: When a ruthless storeowner seems hell-bent on stopping Ton & Allen from scoring new items in Santa Barbara they fight back. The guys uncover a rare antique air-gun and a vintage wooden boat built for speed, if it floats!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey
programme.desc: Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Whip It Good
programme.desc: With a motocross bike and a rare stock whip up for grabs, Ton and Allen face one of their toughest competitors yet: their former employee Carolyn, who knows all their tricks, has money to burn and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Fall Guys
programme.desc: The pressures of running a shop are taking a toll on Ton and Allen and not even the discovery of a stunt-man's fall bag can ease the tension. When things get heated, Ton abandons the partnership and leaves town.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: You Foos You Lose
programme.desc: When their truck breaks down, Ton and Allen lay it all on the line to raise money to fix her. They score a Foosball table, Tommy Gun drums and to Ton's delight, a treasure trove of Twinkies, but will it be enough?

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Haff-Inated
programme.desc: Allen's off his game without his morning coffee, but some fun items help him re-energize. The guys find a wrestling ring, and when Allen uncovers vintage animatronics, they remind him of his days as a theme park boat captain.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Unsinkable Ton
programme.desc: Unique finds lead the guys to some cool sales. They try to authenticate props from the film Titanic, Ton faces off with a rattler during a snakebite kit sale, and Allen gets into ice carving while unloading some chainsaws.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: One Of Our Own
programme.desc: When a fellow police officer is shot and killed in a restaurant, Cagney, and Lacey join in the feverish search for the killer. Meanwhile, Isbecki works to do all that he can to keep the duo off of the precinct's softball team.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Beauty Burglars
programme.desc: Detectives Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are assigned to a special task force to investigate a series of beauty salon robberies. The case becomes more complicated when it is discovered that the burglars are posing as police officers.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: High Steel
programme.desc: Harvey (John Karlen) disagrees with the outcome of an investigation after a former colleague falls to his death at a construction site. Harvey recruits Mary Beth (Tyne Daly) to help him investigate what he believes to be a murder.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Hotline
programme.desc: After three women are found strangled, Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate whether or not there is a connection between the attacks and an erotic hotline. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are assigned by Internal Affairs to check out a security leak among the 14th Precinct's personnel, forcing the duo to reluctantly spy on their colleagues. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Mr. Lonelyhearts
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are called in when an elderly man comes looking for his wife. But a simple missing persons case soon turns into a major bigamy and fraud case. All the while Cagney deals with a suitor.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Conduct Unbecoming
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) team together with another detective, Charles Stephens (guest star Christopher Allport), to investigate an illegal handgun operation. However, their investigation is impeded by Charles's suspension.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: I'll Be Home For Christmas
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are looking forward to an early release on Christmas Eve when a man dressed as Santa Claus (guest star Richard Masur), who has been arrested for charity fraud, escapes from his cell in the 14th precinct.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Recreational Use
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey team up with Sergeant Dory McKenna (guest star Barry Primus) in an investigation of a group of senior citizens terrorized by their landlord. Cagney's romance with Dory is complicated by his addiction to cocaine.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Hopes And Dreams
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) investigate a series of burglaries that occurred while all of the victims were at funerals. They become especially interested in a young teenage victim, who is bound to a wheelchair.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Grandest Jewel Thief Of Them All
programme.desc: Lacey (Tyne Daly) becomes worried when Cagney (Sharon Gless) becomes obsessed with catching notorious jewel thief Albert Grand (guest star Ferdy Mayne), who despite committing several hotel safe robberies has never been convicted.
programme.sub-title: Grandest Jewel Thief Of Them All

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Affirmative Action
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) find that they have very mixed emotions when another female detective (guest star Talia Balsam) is assigned to the 14th precinct. Also staring Al Waxman as Lt. Bert Samuels and Carl Lumbly as Mark Petrie.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Open And Shut Case
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey's (Tyne Daly) faith in the legal system is tested when a solid homicide case crumbles and a friend and former rape victim is forced to relive her courtroom ordeal. Also staring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Jane Doe #37
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) refuses to drop the investigation into a murdered Jane Doe, who also happens to be a homeless woman. Cagney is determined to discover her real identity before her burial. Also starring Tyne Daly, Al Waxman, and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Date Rape

programme.desc: I 'Fraklip fra året der gik' får du de sjoveste øjeblikke fra Brøndby IF, der aldrig nåede skærmen. Grin med, når spillerne snubler i replikkerne, joker bag kulisserne og viser deres menneskelige side fra træningslejre, interviews og hverdagen.
programme.sub-title: Afsnit 1: Fraklip fra året der gik - #1-5

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I 'Vores Brøndby' får det faste hold besøg af Noah Nartey til en snak om livet som prof i dag vs. 90’erne. De vender krav, mediepres og træningskultur, før ung mod gammel klæder to giner i hjemme- og udebanesæt.

programme.title: Udfordringen
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Udfordringen' skyder spillerne Black Friday-rabatter i No Bounce Challenge, mens Alves, Cappis og Maxsø dyster i tre intense udfordringer. Til sidst gælder det præcision og pres i en klassisk crossbar challenge.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Jordi Vanlerberghe om sit første derby, Frederik Birk giver et indblik i rollen som assistenttræner, og Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer en stor milepæl med sine første 100 kampe for Brøndby IF.

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I 'Vores Brøndby' gæster Nikolaj Koppel og sætter ord på fankulturen: fællesskab, traditioner og hvorfor Brøndby betyder så meget for så mange. Til sidst udfordres han til at spille “Jump” på et virkelig dårligt legetøjskeyboard.

programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Følg med, når Joel Kabongo tager mikrofonen og guider dig gennem en helt almindelig træning med Superliga-truppen en januareftermiddag. Få et unikt indblik i tempoet, stemningen og detaljerne, der præger hverdagen på træningsbanen.
programme.sub-title: Reportage - Se hele træningen fra 12. januar

programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.
programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne

programme.desc: Stefan Kuntz, Mario Basler, Fredi Bobic, Ulf Kirsten, Toni Polster i wielu innych zachwycało kibiców swoimi umiejętnościami na boiskach Bundesligi w latach 90. ubiegłego stulecia.
